question: What additional divine companions accompany Rudra in the eastern worship?
premises: Rudra is worshipped in the eastern direction.
Rudra is accompanied by the goddess Gaurī.
Rudra is further endowed with Sarasvatī and joined with the world-guardians and others.
inference: The eastern worship of Rudra includes Sarasvatī and the world-guardians among his accompanying retinue.
plain_english: Worship Rudra endowed with Sarasvatī and accompanied by the world-guardians and others.
